game_title: Fallback: Range Check Bridge – Coral Reef Shallows
game_concept: A tower defense set in Coastal Port – Coral Reef Shallows, reef shallows: the sailor must hold off jellyfish swarms while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Range Check Bridge: Test ranges such as 10 <= weight < 20 to let only the right travelers cross.
theme: Coastal Port – Coral Reef Shallows: reef shallows
core_gameplay_loop: In Coral Reef Shallows, repeat each round: Test ranges such as 10 <= weight < 20 to let only the right travelers cross. Then check bridge_load and advance.
player_objective: Protect the ferry from jellyfish swarms in Coral Reef Shallows: keep bridge_load above zero until the 51-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 8 (extended tier): Range Check Bridge
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 3, Level 8, Standard. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
